visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens behind a large glass window looking into a warm, pink-walled room designed for cats. A man in a black shirt sits on the floor interacting with several felines; wooden climbing boxes and scratching posts are scattered across the room under bright studio lighting. (2) Close-up shots of various cats follow: a large, fluffy Maine Coon with green eyes is petted on the head by a hand; a small ginger kitten peers curiously into the camera; a white Devon Rex with large ears looks directly at the lens. (3) A customer is seen sitting on a chair while a large tabby cat sits comfortably on his lap, leaning its head down as the person's hand strokes its fur; the setting is a cozy indoor cafe with soft wooden textures. (4) The focus shifts to food: a decorative light bulb with a cat silhouette glows on a marble table. Close-ups show a bowl of chicken silk dry noodles topped with a soft-boiled egg, and a seafood udon soup brimming with scallops, squid, and fish belly. (5) The camera moves to a different section of the facility, showing a long hallway lined with glass-fronted cat hotel cubicles and an air purifier. A staff member in a black mask and yellow apron is seen at a stainless steel grooming station. (6) A reception desk with the 'Zodiac' logo is shown where a male and female staff member assist a customer. The final shot is an outdoor view of a large green building with the 'BONEBONE PET STORE' logo under a clear sunny sky.
